Issue #312 — Add a /healthz readiness probe to the API

Labels: good-first-issue, backend
Author: @ext-contributor

## Summary

We need a lightweight `/healthz` endpoint that returns 200 when the
service can reach Postgres, for the k8s readiness probe.

- [ ] `GET /healthz` returns 200 + `{"db":"ok"}` when Postgres is up
